goal: Extract the key SRAM GDS generation mechanisms from OpenRAM and combine them with OpenYield semantics to design a lighter OpenYield-specific self-developed SRAM layout generator.

proposed_modules.name: OpenYield netlist parser
proposed_modules.responsibility: Parse OpenYield netlist semantics, module hierarchy, port roles, and SRAM topology intent.
proposed_modules.why_it_matters: A full physical generator needs an explicit semantic front end.

proposed_modules.name: canonical SRAM parameter model
proposed_modules.responsibility: Derive num_rows, num_cols, mux ratio, address widths, and physical array shape from semantic SRAM parameters.
proposed_modules.why_it_matters: OpenRAM shows that a canonical parameter model is the backbone of the entire flow.

proposed_modules.name: module generator registry
proposed_modules.responsibility: Dispatch array, row-path, column-path, control-path, bank, and top-level generators.
proposed_modules.why_it_matters: The existing registry pattern should be extended instead of discarded.

proposed_modules.name: topology-aware floorplanner
proposed_modules.responsibility: Place array, decoder, WL driver, precharge, sense amp, write driver, and control logic using SRAM-specific topology rules.
proposed_modules.why_it_matters: Candidate assembly floorplanning exists, but not a full SRAM floorplanner.

proposed_modules.name: SRAM-specialized router
proposed_modules.responsibility: Route WL, BL/BR, column select, control, and clock with deterministic SRAM-specific strategies.
proposed_modules.why_it_matters: A full generic router is unnecessary, but SRAM routing logic is mandatory.

proposed_modules.name: power planner
proposed_modules.responsibility: Handle VDD/GND rails, tap and well contact strategy, and top-level power export.
proposed_modules.why_it_matters: Current project has rail metadata but not a full power planning engine.

proposed_modules.name: pin/label exporter
proposed_modules.responsibility: Export top-level pins, pin shapes, labels, LEF pins, and LVS-consistent names.
proposed_modules.why_it_matters: Pin and naming consistency must be maintained across GDS, LEF, and LVS collateral.

proposed_modules.name: GDS writer
proposed_modules.responsibility: Serialize hierarchical layout objects into GDS.
proposed_modules.why_it_matters: A custom GDS backend already exists and should be retained.

proposed_modules.name: DRC/LVS hooks
proposed_modules.responsibility: Provide optional external verification hooks without embedding closure claims into the generator core.
proposed_modules.why_it_matters: Verification should be hookable but remain outside physical generation claims.

final_recommendation: Retain the current GDSWriter, registry pattern, and evidence/report infrastructure. Add a new OpenYield-specific SRAM physical generation core instead of continuing to patch the candidate assembly flow into a full SRAM layout generator.
